name: Tab Recall
author: wpcanbdusa

sections.description:
Tab Recall is a WordPress plugin that notify user to memorize about the site if its inactive.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the tab-recall Folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Visit Tab Recall From WordPress Admin Dashboard And Customize Everything About Notify Informations
